title: Worksheet 13: Who Is a Trusted Adult?
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: A trusted adult is someone in a player's life who they feel safe talking to and who genuinely wants to help keep them safe, such as a parent, guardian, teacher, school counselor, or another close family member. Having a trusted adult to talk to is especially important when playing online games like Roblox, because kids may sometimes see or experience something confusing, upsetting, or unsafe that they aren't sure how to handle on their own. Talking to a trusted adult is never something to feel embarrassed or afraid about, even if a player thinks they might be in trouble for something, such as accidentally clicking a scam link or talking to a stranger they shouldn't have. Trusted adults are generally much more concerned with keeping a child safe than with placing blame, and telling them early can help solve a problem before it becomes bigger. Identifying a trusted adult before a problem happens, rather than waiting until something goes wrong, can make it easier to know exactly who to go to for help.
